_comment: The one-time What's new card on the main menu (ui/main/whats_new_card.gd). Change id for each update; the card shows once per id. Hand-edited.
title: What's new: a cleaner interface

lines.text: Every card has a ⋮ (or right-click) with everything about it.
The map has lenses: Defense, Pressure, Resources and Odds.
In fights, pick a skill to see what it does to every target, with the math.
A short How to play guide is on the main menu.
Big screens: the game scales up to fill any window. F11 or Alt+Enter for fullscreen; Scaling and Interface size in Settings (F10).

feedback: Tell us what you think: press F8 in a run to send a note with a screenshot.
